To install my mod please follow these key instructions.

[list]
[*]Ensure you have the newest Stardew Version (1.6)
[/list][list]
[*]Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]﻿and its latest update.
[/list][list]
[*]Download and set up [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patch[/url]er﻿
[/list][list]
[*]Download the mod & unzip the file
[/list][list]
[*]Place the file in StardewValley/Mods
[/list]﻿

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png[/img]


This mod edits the sewers and krobus! Just head to the sewers and have fun!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]



This mod is not compatible with ANY mod that changes Krobus or the sewers.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ccJ4SPZ.png[/img]
